title: Cambridge International AS & A Level Computer Science (for examination from 2026)

learningObjectives.text: Show understanding of binary magnitudes and the difference between binary prefixes and decimal prefixes

• an interpreter for translation and execution of a high-level language program
Explain the benefits and drawbacks of using either a compiler or interpreter and justify the use of each

subtopics.title: Data Definition Language (DDL) and Data Manipulation Language (DML)
